- `resetUndoHistory()` called on map switch

Done. Here's what was implemented:

**`src/ws/messages.ts`** — Added `FogUndoMessage` interface (`type: 'fog:undo', strokes: FogStroke[]`) and added it to the `ClientMessage` union.

**`src/ws/handler.ts`** — Added `fog:undo` case: creates a fresh mask for the active image, replays all provided strokes, updates the cache, schedules a save, then broadcasts `fog:reset` (with the new base64 mask) to both the GM and all subscribers.

**`public/gm.html`** — Added `#undo-btn` (↩) and `#redo-btn` (↪) inside the existing `#mode-toggle` pill, both initially disabled.

**`public/css/style.css`** — Mode buttons keep their 68px width; undo/redo buttons are 44px wide, same height. Disabled state is 35% opacity, no hover effect.

**`public/js/gm.ts`**:
- `undoStack`/`redoStack`/`currentAction` arrays track stroke history (max 50)
- `performUndo`/`performRedo` pop/push between stacks and send `fog:undo` with the flattened remaining history
- `finishAction()` on `pointerup`/`pointerleave` commits `currentAction` to `undoStack` and clears `redoStack`
- `fog:reset` handler calls `applyFogMask()` when the imageId matches
- `resetUndoHistory()` called on map switch
